integrity.claim_scope: Exact \(C_k(N)\) for all \(k\ge0\) and \(N\ge2\) with at most two distinct prime factors, including the maximum and initial-run distribution.
integrity.evidence: Complete written square-residue fiber/CRT proof plus standalone independent finite cross-check script.
integrity.unproved: No bounds for radicals with three or more distinct prime divisors.

scientific_limitations: Initial square shifts only: indices i=1,2,... with a single fixed residue class x; no conclusion for arbitrary starting index.
Radicals having three or more prime factors, and polynomials other than \(T^2\), are outside the theorem.
Finite computation confirms bounded instances only; the uniform statement rests on the written CRT and local-root argument.
Independent validation of both scientific originality and proof has not been performed.
title: The exact quadratic Jacobsthal spectrum for moduli with at most two prime factors
